about: The cousins the mod can dress the player as, one entry each. 'styles' maps a style key to its .llcm file, relative to this folder (format in FORMAT.md). 'icons' maps a style key to her select-screen icon (a PNG made by Tools/render_icons.py), relative to this folder. 'build' is read only by Tools/export_llcm.py and Tools/check_llcm.py; its paths are relative to the LongLostCousins folder. 'fit' maps a style key to how the player's presents and the stage HUD fit her: 'joint_offsets' (a game joint's name to [x, y, z] cm from her joint of that name, in her joint's axes), 'present_offsets' (a present id to [x, y, z] cm added to its joint's), 'cannot_wear' (present ids she never shows; skinned body suits are never shown anyway), 'type_offsets' (BODY, FACE or HEAD to [x, y, z] cm added for every present of that type), 'hud_scale' and 'hud_offset' (her size and place in the stage HUD's copy of the player only). 'forever' maps a style key to what it needs to play Katamari Forever's motions from the player's own copy (FORMAT.md): 'scale' (her cm per Forever unit), 'axes' (her axis i is axes[i] times Forever's), 'joints' (her joint to the Forever Prince's node that drives it; other joints keep their rest pose), 'states' (an OUAK Animator state name to [pack, slot] of the Forever clip played in it; other states play OUAK's motion). No Forever data is here: the curves, lengths, speeds, loops and faces are read from the player's copy. 'screen' is the cousin's slot on the game's select screen (The Prince & Cousins): 'id' is the mod's id for that slot, 100 to 199, which never reaches the game's save; 'page' and 'slot' count as the player does, and only page 4's free slots 14 to 21 are allowed, each once. A 'forever' style may be {"same_as": "<earlier cousin id>"} to share that cousin's rig and clip table for the same style key.

cousins.name: Burda
cousins.notes: Cousin 26 of the cancelled Katamari Damacy Online, a singer whose head is a sideways microphone. Both styles use OUAK's 23 joint names and rest at identity. The new style has a piece for each of OUAK's 23 face slots plus her singing eyes; the old style shows one of 11 face cards. The old style plays Katamari Forever's motions read from the player's own copy where 'forever' names a clip, and OUAK's motions elsewhere (or everywhere without a copy), with her waist 7.415 cm higher than the Prince's.

new.notes: Her joints are the Prince's, so his presents sit on her with no offset. hud_scale: in the stage HUD (probe, idle) she was 294 px wide against the hidden Prince's 284 px, so 284/294. The Prince's width is the bounds of his switched-off renderers, presents included, which Unity may not keep up to date; a later pose gave 285 against 283. A rough value, not a measured framing; the probe saw no clipping at 1.

old.notes: First offset from her own model, not yet measured in the game: her head top (the microphone, away from the antenna) is 21.061 cm above her JNT_head against the Prince's 14.046 cm (y), and her face front is 3.547 cm further forward than his (z). Her numbers are from burda_old.llcm; the Prince's from the bounds of his head_m (top 88.89, front 15.22) against his JNT_head at 74.844, from the rig check made for this mod. hud_scale: in the stage HUD (probe) she was 284 px wide, as wide as the hidden Prince.

Map from the slice-one research (burda_rig_spec.json old_style.forever_motions, forever_clip_map.json; the clip choices are this mod's). Her old-style joints were built from the Forever Prince's rig at 0.211 m per unit, and Forever's axes become hers turned 180 degrees about y: (x, y, z) -> 21.1 (-x, y, -z).

cousins.name: Circuit
cousins.notes: Cousin 34 of the cancelled Katamari Damacy Online: a hooded figure with two pink-tipped horns, a shield-shaped face window and a green trace on their robe. Both styles use OUAK's 23 joint names, rest at identity, and Burda's rig spec. The new style has a piece for each of OUAK's 23 face slots plus their humming eyes; the old style shows one of 11 face cards. In the new style the horns are the antenna mesh, so they hide where the game hides the antenna; in the old style they are part of the hood. The old style plays the same Katamari Forever clips as Burda's (same rig) where the player's copy is set.

new.notes: First offset from their own model, not yet measured in the game: the top of their hood (between the horns, |x| under 10 cm) is 31.456 cm above their JNT_head against the Prince's 14.046 cm (y), and the front of their hood is 0.698 cm ahead of his face front (z): 15.918 cm ahead of the joint against his 15.22. Their numbers are from Circuit_new.blend; the Prince's are the ones Burda's old-style fit uses. Face presents (type_offsets FACE) take that back and go 5 cm lower than on the Prince, so they sit 5 cm below his eye line and 0.698 cm further forward: the Prince's glasses are centred 8.4 cm above his JNT_head, their eyes about 3 cm above theirs (eye_01_m's top at 3.663 cm). A first guess for the in-game pictures to confirm. hud_scale: not measured yet.

old.notes: First offset from their own model, not yet measured in the game: the top of their hood (between the horns, |x| under 10 cm) is 29.767 cm above their JNT_head against the Prince's 14.046 cm (y), and their face card's front is 2.103 cm behind his (z): 13.117 cm ahead of the joint against his 15.22. Their numbers are from Circuit_old.blend; the Prince's are the ones Burda's old-style fit uses. Face presents (type_offsets FACE) take that back and go 5 cm lower than on the Prince, as in the new style, at his depth (their card lies 0.4 cm behind his glasses). A first guess for the in-game pictures to confirm. hud_scale: not measured yet.

cousins.name: Pew
cousins.notes: The fan-made 'cousin with a gun' (2017): the Prince's head as a pistol, painted metallic grey with near-black panel lines, the face on the muzzle end sunk an inch and a half into it behind a thick black square ring. He wears the Prince's face (grey almond eyes, an orange triangle nose, a small red mouth). OUAK's 23 joint names at Pew's own positions, resting at identity; the waist rests 12.345 cm lower than the Prince's. A piece for each of OUAK's 23 face slots plus their aiming eyes.

new.notes: First guesses from the model, not measured in the game. Presents on the head joint sit over the grip; the slide reaches 0.70 m forward of it.

cousins.name: Pis
cousins.notes: Cousin of the cancelled Katamari Damacy Online: a magenta jigsaw-puzzle piece with a blue stepped bottom, the face on its top tab. The Prince's joints, with the shoulders and arms moved to the piece's top corners (the arms hang outside its sides) and the head, mouth, nose and antenna joints moved to the tab; the head turns on a joint 2 cm below the tab's base. The tab is its own shell, moving only with the head. A piece for each of OUAK's 23 face slots.

new.notes: First guesses from the model, not measured in the game. The tab's top is 7 cm above the Prince's head top.

cousins.name: Rouge
cousins.notes: Cousin of the cancelled Katamari Damacy Online, named for her lipstick-shaped head: a metallic pink lipstick with a slanted top, its high corner over her face with the antenna on it, a darker pink band over a metallic gold ring, over a brown head of hair. Her face is in a square gold window under the ring, with her hair laid out as the art shows it, and she wears the Prince's face. Below a narrower neck her dress is patterned as the art's back view (a brown upper body, a hot-pink side with a darker stripe, curved medium- and light-pink stripes) with a gold hem; really short brown sleeves with gold cuffs. Taller and skinnier than the art. OUAK's 23 joint names at her own positions, resting at identity; her waist rests 2.79 cm higher than the Prince's. A piece for each of OUAK's 23 face slots.

new.notes: First guesses from the model, not measured in the game. Her head joint is under her face window, so presents on the head ride on the lipstick.
